form.label: IRIS — Tracker & Transfer Health
form.description: Tracker and transfer health with measured device peer captures. The device filter selects receivers in transfer panels and the named peer in tracker panels. All searches use the selected window; active tiles additionally require observations within the last 15 minutes from now. Telemetry last seen covers the full index.

search.query: index=iris_logs "iris.peer.role"=* | eval Peer=replace('iris.principal',"^device:","") | search Peer=$dev|s$ | stats latest("iris.peer.role") as Role latest(_time) as Seen by Peer "iris.torrent.info_hash" | where Seen>=relative_time(now(),"-15m") AND Role="seeder" | stats dc(Peer) as Seeders

index=iris_logs "iris.peer.role"=* | eval Peer=replace('iris.principal',"^device:","") | search Peer=$dev|s$ | stats latest("iris.peer.role") as Role latest(_time) as Seen by Peer "iris.torrent.info_hash" | where Seen>=relative_time(now(),"-15m") AND Role="leecher" | stats dc(Peer) as Leechers

index=iris_logs "iris.peer.role"=* | eval Peer=replace('iris.principal',"^device:","") | search Peer=$dev|s$ | stats earliest(eval(if('iris.peer.role'="leecher",_time,null()))) as Started earliest(eval(if('iris.peer.role'="seeder",_time,null()))) as Seeded by Peer "iris.torrent.info_hash" | where isnotnull(Started) AND isnotnull(Seeded) AND Seeded>=Started | eval Minutes=round((Seeded-Started)/60,1) | stats avg(Minutes) as "Average minutes" | eval "Average minutes"=round('Average minutes',1)
index=iris_logs | stats latest(_time) as Last | eval "Seconds ago"=round(now()-Last,0) | fields "Seconds ago"

index=iris_logs "iris.peer.role"=* | eval Peer=replace('iris.principal',"^device:","") | search Peer=$dev|s$ | bin _time span=5m | stats latest("iris.peer.role") as Role by _time Peer "iris.torrent.info_hash" | chart dc(Peer) over _time by Role

index=iris_logs "otel.log.name"="iris.swarm.peer_rate" | eval Peer=replace('iris.principal',"^device:","") | search Peer=$dev|s$ | timechart span=5m avg("iris.transfer.peer_send_bps") as bps | eval "Average Mbps"=round(bps/1000000,2) | fields - bps

index=iris_logs "otel.log.name"="iris.device.transfer.report" | search "device.id"=$dev|s$ | stats latest("iris.transfer.bytes_from_devices_total") as Devices latest("iris.transfer.bytes_from_origin_total") as Origin latest("iris.transfer.bytes_from_unknown_total") as Unknown latest("iris.transfer.bytes_unattributed_omitted") as Omitted by "iris.transfer.id" | stats sum(Devices) as Devices sum(Origin) as Origin sum(Unknown) as Unknown sum(Omitted) as "Untraced capped rows" | transpose 0 header_field=column | rename "row 1" as Bytes, column as Source | eval "Received GB"=round(Bytes/1024/1024/1024,2) | fields Source "Received GB"

index=iris_logs "iris.peer.role"=* | eval Device=replace('iris.principal',"^device:","") | search Device=$dev|s$ | stats earliest(eval(if('iris.peer.role'="leecher",_time,null()))) as Started earliest(eval(if('iris.peer.role'="seeder",_time,null()))) as Seeded by Device "iris.torrent.info_hash" | where isnotnull(Started) AND isnotnull(Seeded) AND Seeded>=Started | eval "Minutes to seed"=round((Seeded-Started)/60,1), Started=strftime(Started,"%F %T"), Seeded=strftime(Seeded,"%F %T") | rename "iris.torrent.info_hash" as Torrent | table Device Torrent Started Seeded "Minutes to seed" | sort - "Minutes to seed"

index=iris_logs "otel.log.name"="iris.device.transfer.report" | search "device.id"=$dev|s$ | where 'iris.transfer.content_sha256.state'!="verified" OR 'iris.transfer.ios_copy_verify.state'!="ok" | stats latest(_time) as Seen latest("iris.report.event") as Stage latest("iris.image.id") as Image latest("iris.transfer.content_sha256.state") as Checksum latest("iris.transfer.ios_copy_verify.state") as "Copy verify" by "device.id" | eval Seen=strftime(Seen,"%F %T") | rename "device.id" as Device | table Seen Device Image Stage Checksum "Copy verify" | sort - Seen

panel.title: Active seeds and leechers by device type

search.query: index=iris_logs ("iris.peer.role"=* OR "iris.image.id"=*) | eval Device=coalesce('device.id',replace('iris.principal',"^device:","")) | search Device=$dev|s$ | rename "iris.peer.role" as PeerRole, "iris.image.id" as ImageId | stats latest(PeerRole) as Role latest(eval(if(isnotnull(PeerRole),_time,null()))) as RoleSeen latest(ImageId) as Image by Device | where RoleSeen>=relative_time(now(),"-15m") | eval "Device type"=case(like(Image,"c8000v%"),"Catalyst 8000V",like(Image,"8000-%"),"Cisco 8000 / IOS XR",like(Image,"cat9k%"),"Catalyst 9000",like(Image,"ie3x00%"),"IE 3000",true(),"Unclassified") | chart dc(Device) over "Device type" by Role

panel.title: Bytes received, by source
panel.description: Cumulative bytes each device reported receiving, grouped by the selected capture's hour and stacked by who sent them: origin (the seeder), peer device (another IRIS device), unknown (a peer the server could not name — a normal outcome, not an error). A visible "peer device" band is the direct evidence that peer-to-peer distribution carried load. Report pulls do not add bytes. These capture totals are not an hourly traffic rate, and an empty bucket is not proof of zero traffic.

search.query: index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.device.peer_transfer_record" | dedup "event.id" | eval received_bytes=tonumber('iris.transfer.session_bytes_from_peer') | sort 0 -received_bytes | dedup "device.id" "iris.image.id" "iris.transfer.id" "network.peer.address" | search "device.id"=$dev|s$ | eval source=case('iris.peer.attribution'=="origin","origin",'iris.peer.attribution'=="device","peer device",1==1,"unknown") | eval MiB=received_bytes/1048576 | timechart span=1h sum(MiB) BY source

panel.title: Share of bytes from peer devices

search.query: index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.device.peer_transfer_record" | dedup "event.id" | eval received_bytes=tonumber('iris.transfer.session_bytes_from_peer') | sort 0 -received_bytes | dedup "device.id" "iris.image.id" "iris.transfer.id" "network.peer.address" | search "device.id"=$dev|s$ | eval b=received_bytes | stats sum(eval(if('iris.peer.attribution'=="device",b,null()))) AS peer_bytes, sum(b) AS all_bytes | eval pct=if(isnull(all_bytes) OR all_bytes<=0,null(),round(100*coalesce(peer_bytes,0)/all_bytes,1)) | fields pct

single.option: Measured on receiving devices: peer-device bytes ÷ all captured bytes for the selected receivers and time window. Origin and unknown bytes are included. Repeated cumulative captures count once. Missing captures are unavailable; origin-only captures measure 0%. Captured bytes are exact for retained peers; incomplete captures make traffic totals a floor and the percentage partial, with unknown bias.

panel.title: Peer-to-peer transfers (measured, device-reported)
panel.description: Receiving-device filter; Sender names the other device. Capture time is when the cumulative counters were read, not when every byte arrived. A false completeness flag means peers may be missing.

search.query: index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.device.peer_transfer_record" | dedup "event.id" | eval received_bytes=tonumber('iris.transfer.session_bytes_from_peer') | sort 0 -received_bytes | dedup "device.id" "iris.image.id" "iris.transfer.id" "network.peer.address" | where 'iris.peer.attribution'=="device" | search "device.id"=$dev|s$ | eval "Bytes from this peer"=received_bytes | eval "MiB from this peer"=round(received_bytes/1048576,1) | eval Image=coalesce('iris.image.name','iris.image.id') | rename "iris.peer.device_id" AS Sender, "device.id" AS Receiver, "iris.transfer_record.capture_complete" AS "Capture complete" | table _time, Sender, Receiver, Image, "Bytes from this peer", "MiB from this peer", "Capture complete" | sort - _time | head 100 | appendpipe [ stats count AS n | where n==0 | eval Sender="— no device-to-device peer transfer records in this window (none captured, which is not the same as none happened) —" | fields Sender ]
